A1.justification: Both PDFs are readable 19-page versions of the same GeoThinker paper. The main text, appendices A–J, equations, Tables 1–12, and Figures 1–8 support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original GeoThinker experiments on spatial reasoning, embodied referring, and autonomous driving, together with appendix benchmark results, ablations, efficiency measurements, and visual analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including the spatial benchmark comparisons, downstream evaluations, and appendix experiments.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix B retain the same frame-strict cross-attention, importance gating, global scaling, layer selection, and spatial compression. No algorithm or model component changes.

E1.justification: Training data and evaluation coverage are unchanged, including the downstream tasks and appendix benchmarks. The added EASI citation does not introduce evaluation coverage: Appendix E and Table 9 already report EASI results in v1.

E2.justification: Comparator membership remains unchanged in the corresponding comparisons, including VG-LLM, Cambrian-S, SenseNova-SI, RoboRefer, and ReCogDrive. The newly cited works are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: The reported training budgets, backbones, data mixtures, metrics, and testing procedures are unchanged. Both versions retain the same 8/32-frame training configurations and frame-extrapolation evaluations through 128 frames.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same component and fusion-ratio ablations, video-mixture and debiasing analyses, frame extrapolation, computational-cost comparisons, and importance-score visualizations, including resolution robustness.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random-seed settings, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests for the experiments.

E6.justification: Reported numerical results and qualitative experimental findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 2 retains GeoThinker Qwen3VL-8B's 62.23 average and 72.6 VSI-Bench score, while Appendix E retains EASI rank 6 and an average of 55.0.

T1.justification: The mathematical representations, fusion definitions, and Equations (1)–(5) are unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets, and conclusion retain the same claims about active geometry integration, leading spatial-reasoning performance, robustness, and transfer to embodied referring and autonomous driving.

C2.justification: Interpretations and limitations are retained, including the explanation of failure when fusing into every layer in Appendix D.2 and sensitivity to geometric-encoder accuracy in Appendix J.1. No substantive qualification or mechanism explanation changes.

D1.justification: Section 4 and Appendix B retain the same hyperparameters, hardware, data composition, compression details, and layer-selection settings. The code-access statement and link are also unchanged.

R1.justification: v3 adds four references: 3D-MoRe, A0, NaVid, and Cai et al.'s holistic spatial-intelligence evaluation paper. Sections 1–2 modestly broaden background attribution and mention SenseNova-SI's EASI performance; the central research positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 replaces the erroneous running header 'Submission and Formatting Instructions for ICML 2026' with the paper title, updates version dates, and makes limited citation-related additions in Sections 1–2. The narrative and section organization are retained.

P2.justification: The running header changes, added references cause local reflow, and Table 11 moves upward within the right column of page 15. All figures and tables retain their substantive content and display designs.

improvement.justification: Correcting the template running header and adding references for EASI and the embodied/VLA background modestly improve presentation and attribution. The gain is limited: the scientific evidence, technical disclosures, and limitations remain unchanged.
